description: Update fields on an existing opportunity. Only provided fields change. Twenty REST: PATCH /rest/opportunities/{id}.

amountMicros.description: Opportunity amount in micros (× 1,000,000). Sent as amount:{amountMicros,currencyCode}.

currencyCode.description: Currency code for the amount (default USD; only sent when amountMicros is provided).

extra.description: Passthrough object of additional/custom fields merged into the request body verbatim.

stage.description: Pipeline stage — e.g. SCREENING, MEETING, PROPOSAL, NEGOTIATION, CUSTOMER (custom pipelines vary).

name: twenty_update_opportunity
title: Update opportunity
